decisions.reason: Because this semi-hard cheese stayed in the range after the first launch phase while other 2018 novelties were removed, and because it fits the firm's established organic cheese business closely, management would likely judge it as meeting aspiration levels and keep it unless new evidence turns negative.

This spicy cheese also survived the initial comparison with sister launches, but its more specific taste profile makes demand somewhat less certain, so management would still keep it while accepting a moderate risk of withdrawal if results slip below aspiration.

The mild creamy soft cheese appears to have earned a stable place in the assortment and broadens the existing cheese line with limited capability strain, so in a growing industry and without visible distress the firm would likely keep it.
